figurative_meaning_en: Having nothing but bones in the body
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুর্ভিক্ষের পর সে কঙ্কালসার হয়ে গিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After the famine, he became skin and bones.
Due to the side effects of the medicine, his appearance turned emaciated.
note: This idiom vividly describes extreme thinness, often linked to hardship in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
